title: HB257 (2021 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2021/bills/HB257_.HTM; sha256 d73c30f403ab9425e59891cc8ac6de49cc7137c9d3291a0b89b24c0c799487b6)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed; no passage vote on file. The core change (strikes the state criminal-justice-data-center and rap back checks, leaving the federal instant check; strikes county police authority in 846-2.7(b)(43)) is described in the bill's Description; quotes are unchanged-looking sentences from the amended sections because the changed sentences run across struck text.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (HRS 134-2): Permits issued to acquire any pistol or revolver shall be void unless used within ten days after the date of issue. Permits to acquire a pistol or revolver shall require a separate application and permit for each transaction.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-3): Every person who acquires a firearm pursuant to section 134-2 shall register the firearm in the manner prescribed by this section within five days of acquisition.
